preconditions.description: The number of intersections in Mike's city is between 1 and 200,000, inclusive.
Each shortcut allows walking from intersection i to intersection a_i, where a_i is between i and n, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: a_i <= a_{i+1} for all i < n
preconditions.description: The shortcuts are non-decreasing in their destination intersections.

postconditions.description: The energy required to reach intersection 1 from itself is 0.
The energy required to reach any intersection is non-negative.

postconditions.expression: 1 <= i <= n implies m_i = min(m_j + |j - i| for all j such that 1 <= j < i)
postconditions.description: The minimum energy required to reach intersection i is the minimum energy required to reach any intersection j plus the energy required to walk from j to i.
